mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MSG_ID, EMPNO, SENDER_NAME, CONTENT, SENT_AT) VALUES (CHAT_MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, #{senderName}, #{content}, SYSDATE + 9/24)
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MSG_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, SENDER_NAME, CONTENT, SENT_AT) VALUES (CHAT_MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{empno}, #{deptno}, #{senderName}, #{content}, SYSDATE + 9/24)
mapper.select: SELECT MSG_ID, EMPNO, DEPTNO, SENDER_NAME, CONTENT, TO_CHAR(SENT_AT, 'HH24:MI') AS SENT_AT FROM ( SELECT * FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE DEPTNO IS NULL ORDER BY MSG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit} ORDER BY MSG_ID ASC
